correctness.rationale: Hub and independent leaf Lipschitz inequalities reconstruct the primal feasible set exactly. Optimizing leaf signs, substituting nonnegative cap variables, and proving fractional monotonicity between finite arm knots yields the stated equality including t=0/constant-potential boundary. The exact H(r) threshold, strictly decreasing piecewise-affine root, and sorted tail switch enumeration prove the near-linear arithmetic algorithm. Standalone exact rational grid/root comparisons passed 4,800 cases and a structurally independent SciPy primal LP passed 2,100 randomized comparisons; finite tests are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The dual bounded-Lipschitz norm measures signed discrepancies and total-mass changes. Unequal arm lengths are a motivated natural family not resolved by the existing equiradial two-branch calculation. The theorem gives a full invariant formula, explicit attaining potentials, and a uniform O(m log m) exact algorithm, replacing generic LP enumeration on this family; its result and complexity make the contribution structurally meaningful rather than a routine finite table.
